How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at ICGEB?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Associate position at ICGEB is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline, along with experience in advanced molecular biology techniques.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Research Associate vacancy at ICGEB?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email. Ensure you include all necessary documents and clearly state the post applied for in the subject line.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate position will be as per DST norms.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for ICGEB Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of ICGEB?
faq.answer: The official website of the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) is www.icgeb.org.
